the external defects of the metallic products in horizontal continuous casting are the result of a combination of two solidification mechanisms, twin growth of the static skin and twin growth of the dynamic skin, and that the defects are not only the result of the solidification mechanism, but also of the mould design, of the process conditions (speeds of extraction and of feeding, temperature of mould) and of the alloy composition.
